name: Replit
verification_override: replit.com/pricing defaults to the Yearly toggle; Monthly is JS-only. In the verbatim render (fetched/replit.md or r.jina.ai) each paid card reads "$<monthly> $<annual> / month, billed annually": the first figure (struck through on the page) is the monthly no-commitment price (base_price.amount); the second is the annual rate. Never record the second figure, a discount badge ("Up to 10% off", "Save $X") or a derived number as the monthly price. Use only replit.com/pricing — third-party sources show outdated prices.
